text: Welcome.
That conversation is over.
Some of it may still be in your body.
You don't have to sort it out right now.
Find a position where your whole body feels supported.
Let your eyes close, or soften your gaze toward the floor.
Take a deep breath in.
And let it all the way out.
Now the jaw.
This is where so much of the day gets held.
Notice how you're holding it right now.
Let your teeth come apart.
A small space between them.
Your tongue resting low and soft.
This is how a jaw feels when it's off duty.
Let that ease move down into your shoulders.
Let them lower, away from your ears.
Your hands open.
Fingers resting, heavy and warm.
If the conversation starts replaying, you don't need to stop it.
Notice it, and come back to the jaw.
Teeth apart.
Shoulders down.
Hands open.
Whatever was said, you're still here.
Feel your feet on the ground.
Feel your hands.
You don't need the last word to know what you meant.
You can return to this anytime.
One breath, teeth apart, shoulders down.
Take one more breath in.
And let it go, slow.
Carry this ease with you.
Thank you for being here.
